verificationScope: Official examination formats, durations, scored/unscored counts and scoring terminology. Website presets are preserved and explicitly distinguished; this is not a claim of official blueprint/content equivalence.

scoring.section: I passed. What was my score?
scoring.siteTargetMeaning: UpSkill Sprint practice target; not an ASQ passing percentage or pass probability

cssbb.disclosure: This site preset scores all 165 questions and allows 270 minutes. ASQ computer delivery has 165 items (150 scored), 258 exam minutes and a 270-minute appointment. The site timer is a practice preset, not the official exam clock.

cqe.disclosure: This site uses a 160-question, 300-minute scored practice preset (paper-exam length and time), not the current 175-item, 318-minute ASQ computer-delivered exam.

cssgb.disclosure: The site uses the ASQ computer-delivery length and exam time (110 items, 258 minutes), but scores every practice question. ASQ scores 100 items and includes 10 unscored items.

cmq.disclosure: This site preset scores 150 questions in 270 minutes. It is not the ASQ computer format (180 items, 165 scored, 258 exam minutes) or paper format (165 questions, 240 minutes).

mbb.disclosure: Site Set 1/Mixed use 100 questions; Sets 2/3 use 175, paced at 90 seconds per question (262 minutes 30 seconds for 175 questions). These are practice presets. ASQ uses 110 multiple-choice items plus a performance-based assessment within 320 exam minutes.
